mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not lead to negative returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), labor market slack compresses wage growth and reduces inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts rate (HOUST) signals strong demand for residential construction, correlating with robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, correlating with economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO) and slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110 and GDPC1 < 18700, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 255), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 255, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
